description.en:
Increases FS25's native wheel terrain-displacement strength for deeper physical ruts.
The game still determines deformation from ground type, moisture, vehicle weight, tire width, and speed.
Four in-game rut-depth presets: - Off / Base Game: 1.00x - Default: 1.75x - Medium: 2.25x - High: 2.50x
Change the preset under Game Settings -> Deep Ruts. Default is 1.75x.
Compatible by design with: - Mud System Physics - Use Up Your Tyres
This mod changes only terrain displacement. It does not replace mud traction, tire-pressure, tire-wear, wheel-radius, or extra-sink systems.

text.name: dmr_settingRutDepthDescription
text.en: Controls native terrain displacement depth. The server host or administrator controls this setting in multiplayer.
